use default
use Raster.Anchor
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.DateTime
use System.Globalization.CultureInfo
use System.Math

let cycles = [("Physical", 23), ("Emotional", 28), ("Mental", 33)]

let quadrants = [
    ("up and rising", "peak"),
    ("up but falling", "transition"),
    ("down and falling", "valley"),
    ("down but rising", "transition")
]

date(text: string) -> DateTime =>
    DateTime.parse(text, CultureInfo.invariant_culture)

show(d: DateTime) -> string => d.to_string("yyyy-MM-dd")

level(position: int, length: int) -> double =>
    Math.sin(2.0D * Math.pi * cast double(position) / cast double(length))

report(birth: DateTime, target: DateTime) is
    let days = cast int((target - birth).total_days)

    write_line("{show(birth)} to {show(target)}, day {days}:")

    for (label, length) in cycles do
        let position = days % length
        let quadrant = position * 4 / length
        let value = level(position, length)
        let percentage = Math.floor(value * 1000.0D) / 10.0D

        let description =
            if percentage > 95.0D then
                "peak"
            elif percentage < -95.0D then
                "valley"
            elif Math.abs(percentage) < 5.0D then
                "critical transition"
            else
                let (trend, next) = quadrants[quadrant] in
                let ahead = (quadrant + 1) * length / 4 - position in
                let due = show(target.add_days(cast double(ahead))) in
                "{percentage}% ({trend}, next {next} {due})"
            fi

        write_line("  {label} day {position}: {description}")
    od

    write_line("")
si

report(date("1943-03-09"), date("1972-07-11"))
report(date("1809-01-12"), date("1863-11-19"))

let birth = date("1943-03-09")
let target = date("1972-07-11")
let centre = cast int((target - birth).total_days)
let span = 16
let wide = cast double(span)

let image = IMAGE(480, 240)

image.view(-wide - 1.0D, -1.55D, wide + 1.0D, 1.75D)
image.clear(252ub, 250ub, 245ub)

image.colour(200ub, 200ub, 205ub)
image.stroke(1.0D)
image.line(-wide, 0.0D, wide, 0.0D)
image.line(0.0D, -1.2D, 0.0D, 1.2D)

let colours = [
    (200ub, 50ub, 40ub), (40ub, 130ub, 60ub), (40ub, 80ub, 180ub)
]

for (i, (label, length)) in cycles |> index() do
    let (r, g, b) = colours[i]

    image.colour(r, g, b)
    image.stroke(2.0D)
    image.line(
        (-span * 4::span * 4)
            |> map(q =>
                let day = cast double(q) / 4.0D in
                let turn =
                    (cast double(centre) + day) / cast double(length) in
                (x = day, y = Math.sin(2.0D * Math.pi * turn)))
            |> collect_list())
    image.text(-wide + 10.0D * cast double(i), 1.45D, 13.0D, label)
od

image.colour(60ub, 60ub, 60ub)
image.text(0.0D, -1.45D, 12.0D, show(target), Anchor.CENTRE)

image.write("biorhythms.png")

image.show("biorhythms.png")

    Math.sin(2.0D * Math.pi * cast double(position) / cast double(length))

report(birth: DateTime, target: DateTime) is
    let days = cast int((target - birth).total_days)

    write_line("{show(birth)} to {show(target)}, day {days}:")

    for (label, length) in cycles do
        let position = days % length

        let value = level(position, length)
        let percentage = Math.floor(value * 1000.0D) / 10.0D

            elif percentage < -95.0D then

            elif Math.abs(percentage) < 5.0D then

                let ahead = (quadrant + 1) * length / 4 - position in
                let due = show(target.add_days(cast double(ahead))) in
